title: Oscar and the Colony
author: Mara Winterbourne
blurb: Lena Fairweather, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
